name: CE_STATEMENT_LINES_INT
description: CE_STATEMENT_LINES_INT contains information about statement lines data.

columns.name: STATEMENT_LINE_INT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the statement line in the interface.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_INT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key of the bank statement header interface.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequential number of the statement line in the interface.

columns.name: TRX_CODE
columns.description: Bank transaction code identified by the issuer.

columns.name: ORIG_TRX_CODE
columns.description: Original transaction code reported by the bank.

columns.name: DOMAIN
columns.description: ISO domain associated with the statement line.

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: ISO family associated with the statement line.

columns.name: SUB_FAMILY
columns.description: ISO subfamily associated with the statement line.

columns.name: TRX_TYPE
columns.description: Transaction type associated with the statement line.

columns.name: CREDIT_DEBIT_IND
columns.description: Identifies whether the line amount included in the entry amount is positive (credit) or negative (debit).

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount cleared by the bank for this statement line.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Statement line currency. Mostly, same as bank account currency.

columns.name: REVERSAL_IND_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the statement line is reversed.

columns.name: SERVICER_STATUS
columns.description: Status of entry on books of the account service.

columns.name: BOOKING_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when an entry is posted to an account and on the books of an account servicer.

columns.name: VALUE_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when assets become available or cease to be available to the account owner.

columns.name: ACCNT_SERVICER_REF
columns.description: Reference of the account servicing institution for entry.

columns.name: COMM_WAIVER_IND_FLAG
columns.description: Commission waiver indicator flag.

columns.name: TRX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the underlying transaction.

columns.name: TRX_CURR_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the underlying transaction.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Factor used for the conversion of an amount from one currency to another.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when an exchange rate is quoted.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type used in foreign exchange.

columns.name: ADDENDA_TXT
columns.description: Addendum reported in the electronic file.

columns.name: CONTRACT_IDENTIFICATION
columns.description: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the foreign exchange contract.

columns.name: INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by an instructing party to unambiguously identify the instructed party.

columns.name: END_TO_END_ID
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unambiguously identify the transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by the first instructing agent to unambiguously identify the transaction.

columns.name: ORIG_BANK_ACCOUNT
columns.description: A depository financial institution. Data is reported for accounts held.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_REFERENCE
columns.description: Used by BAI2 format. Alphanumeric field defined by the originator.

columns.name: CHECK_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the check number of the underlying transaction.

columns.name: CLEARING_SYSTEM_REF
columns.description: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a payment instruction that is assigned by the clearing system.

columns.name: REVERSAL_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the statement line reversal reason.

columns.name: STRUCTURED_PAYMENT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Structured payment or receipt reference on bank statement line. Used for reconciliation.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
